record.title: Identify the stock splash screen's startup wait
record.intent: Locate the first unresolved initialization dependency after scoped admission and labeling.
requirements: Keep the APK, official firmware and original guest image byte-identical.
Observe framework, JNI, native stacks and filesystem or device boundaries without substituting behavior.
Preserve stable system_server teardown, exact-stock controls and fresh guest state.
Stop before introducing a hardware behavioral model or changing host security or physical devices.
acceptance: Inspect the exact stock DEX and relevant native code with reproducible local provenance.
Capture a bounded live startup trace, process maps and stacks that explain the surviving splash screen.
Repeat the decisive observation on fresh guest state or provide an independent corroborating witness.
Separate missing environment state, blocking instrument IO, rendering failure and instrumentation effects.
